\begin{abstract}
Problem: estimate supplier demand for a bounded planning scenario.
Method: use an interpretable regression baseline and compare it with two simple alternatives.
Result: the supplier demand forecast remains within 88 to 96 units and RMSE is 1.05.
Conclusion: demand remains within the observed planning range for the stable supplier group.
\end{abstract}

The method baseline is linked to \cite{method2024}. A background-only reference is listed as \cite{background2023} and requires manual review.

Figure diagnostic_prediction shows the prediction versus observed demand and supports claim_prediction_stability.
